programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Howling Man
programmes.d: Seeking refuge from a storm, traveler David Ellington comes upon a bizarre hermitage of monks, who have imprisoned a man who begs for his help. When David confronts the head monk Brother Jerome, he is told that the man is the devil, and David must decide

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Eye of the Beholder
programmes.d: A young woman lying in a hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, awaits the outcome of a surgical procedure performed by the State in a last-ditch attempt to make her look 'normal'.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Lateness of the Hour
programmes.d: The daughter of an inventor objects to their 'perfect' home where they are waited on by mechanical servants.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Trouble with Templeton
programmes.d: A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A Most Unusual Camera
programmes.d: When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Night of the Meek
programmes.d: After a derelict Santa Claus is fired on Christmas Eve, he finds a mysterious bag that gives out presents. With this bag, he sets out to fulfill his one wish - to see the less fortunate inherit the bounties of Christmas.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Dust
programmes.d: In a tragic, western town, a desperate father begs for clemency as his son is slated to die for an accident he could not have prevented.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Back There
programmes.d: At a prominent club in Washington, D.C., a socialite argues about whether it would be possible to change history by traveling back in time. When he leaves the club he finds himself in 1865, on the night that President Lincoln will be shot.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Whole Truth
programmes.d: A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Invaders
programmes.d: When a woman investigates a clamor on the roof of her rural house, she discovers a small UFO and little aliens emerging from it. Or so it seems.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Penny For Your Thoughts
programmes.d: Gaining telepathic abilities when his coin lands on its edge bank clerk Hector B. Poole learns about the difference between other people's plans and fantasies.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Twenty-Two
programmes.d: While in the hospital recovering from overwork, Liz Powell keeps dreaming about going down to the hospital morgue.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Odyssey of Flight 33
programmes.d: Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Dingle, the Strong
programmes.d: A timid vacuum-cleaner salesman is given the strength of 300 men by some experimenting aliens.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Static
programmes.d: An old radio is taking bitter bachelor Ed Lindsay back to a happier time before what he considers worthless tripe on television when he starts picking up radio programs from the 1930's and 1940's.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Prime Mover
programmes.d: A compulsive gambler cajoles his friend to use his telekinesis to affect the results of the gambling tables in Las Vegas.

programmes.t: Prom Night (1980)
programmes.d: I denne klassiske gyserfilm med Jamie Lee Curtis (Halloween) i hovedrollen forfølger en maskeret morder fire teenagere, der var ansvarlige for en lokal piges død seks år tidligere. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programmes.t: Prom Night 2: Hello Mary Lou
programmes.d: Tredive år efter hendes uheldige død ved skoleballet i 1957 vender den plagede ånd af skoleballets dronning Mary Lou Maloney tilbage for at søge hævn. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programmes.t: Apartment 1303
programmes.d: Sammen med sine venner fejrer Janet (Julianne Michelle) at hun er flyttet ind i sin nye lejlighed på 13. etage, men i løbet af aftenen springer hun uventet ud fra altanen og begår selvmord.

programmes.t: Apollo 18
programmes.d: Ifølge de amerikanske myndigheder var Apollo 17 den sidste bemandede rumrejse til månen. Men vedvarende rygter har længe hævdet, at en tophemmelig Apollo 18-ekspedition blev sendt af sted kort tid efter i 1973.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Girl I Married
programmes.d: An attorney and his wife have successful careers. They feel something is lacking in their marriage. Soon, they encounter younger versions of their mates.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Curious Case of Edgar Witherspoon
programmes.d: A woman tries to get her Uncle Edgar committed, believing that he is senile. The investigating doctor finds Edgar living in an apartment containing all kinds of junk.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Extra Innings
programmes.d: Ex-baseball player Ed Hamler, lame from an injury and forced to retire early is given a 1909 baseball card of a player that looks exactly like him. The card is magical in that he becomes drawn into it and lives out the life of the player in the past.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Crossing
programmes.d: A stressed-out priest repeatedly encounters a station wagon containing a young girl. The car keeps crashing and bursting into flames.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Hunters
programmes.d: A young boy falls into an undiscovered cave near a housing project. An archeologist studies strange paintings on its walls and then bizarre things begin to happen. Cave items move around and animals are killed and brought into the cave.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Dream Me a Life
programmes.d: A man in a retirement home dreams of a woman holding back a monster, and in real life realizes the woman is his cataleptic neighbor.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Memories
programmes.d: A hypnotist who specializes in helping people relive their past lives tries to find her own history. She hypnotizes herself and when she awakens, she learns that everyone can now remember their past lives. They also desperately want to forget them.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Hellgramite Method
programmes.d: An alcoholic goes through an extremely painful and potentially deadly cure for his drinking problem. He has to choose which is more important - the bottle or his life.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Our Selina is Dying
programmes.d: A young woman, Debra, comes to live with her mysterious family, including the dying patriarch Selena. After Selena clutches Debra's hand firmly leaving an odd spot on it, Debra begins to age very fast while Selena rejuvenates.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Call
programmes.d: A lonely man accidentally phones the wrong number and finds an intriguing female to whom he grows attached. When she refuses to meet him, he investigates and finds the phone in a museum next to the statue of a woman.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Trance
programmes.d: A scam artist purports to channel the spirit of Delos, a former inhabitant of Atlantis. Together with a partner, he makes a living off of it.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Acts of Terror
programmes.d: A woman terrorized by her abusive husband finds some small consolation in a statue of a dog given to her by her sympathetic sister

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Twenty-Twenty Vision
programmes.d: Newly promoted bank loan officer Warren Cribbens cracks his eyeglasses and discovers he can see the future through them. Faced with seeing the future of the farmers whose farms he must foreclose on, Warren can't bring himself to foreclose.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: There Was an Old Woman
programmes.d: A writer of children's books gives a book to a sick young fan. Later, she starts hearing the sound of children in her house.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Trunk
programmes.d: A young man at a motel discovers an empty trunk that grants any wishes. He uses it for popularity, but at a party he discovers who his true friends are.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Appointment on route 17
programmes.d: After finishing a heart transplant, a man finds his personality has changed. He also discovers that he has a strange attraction to a waitress at a road diner.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?
programmes.d: Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: One for the Angels
programmes.d: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Denton on Doomsday
programmes.d: A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
programmes.d: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.
